async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # The page is already on the Product Reviews page with View per page set to 200
    # Get all product rows by filtering out the header row
    header_row = page.get_by_role('row', name='ID Product Name Number of Reviews Avg. Rating Avg. Approved Rating Last Review Action')
    product_rows = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has_not=header_row)
    total_not_useful_reviews = 0

    # Iterate through each product row
    for i in range(await product_rows.count()):
        row = product_rows.nth(i)
        # Get the 'Show Reviews' link in this row
        show_reviews_link = row.get_by_role('link', name='Show Reviews')
        # Click the link and wait for navigation to the review details page
        async with page.expect_navigation():
            await show_reviews_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Allow time for page load

        # On the review details page, search for review content
        # Look for elements that might contain review text, such as cells or generic text elements
        # Use page.get_by_role('cell') to find cells that could have review text
        cells = page.get_by_role('cell')
        for j in range(await cells.count()):
            cell = cells.nth(j)
            cell_text = await cell.inner_text()
            # Count occurrences of 'not useful' in the cell text (case-insensitive)
            count = cell_text.lower().count('not useful')
            total_not_useful_reviews += count

        # Also check for other text elements like paragraphs or spans if cells don't capture all
        # Use page.get_by_text() to find any text containing 'not useful' directly
        not_useful_elements = page.get_by_text('not useful', exact=False)
        count_elements = await not_useful_elements.count()
        total_not_useful_reviews += count_elements  # Each element is a separate occurrence

        # Navigate back to the product reviews page
        await page.go_back()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        await asyncio.sleep(1)  # Allow time for page load

    # After processing all products, return the total count
    return total_not_useful_reviews
